sections.title: CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS/MID-MO VALLEY
sections.text: A SUBTLE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE INTO THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS TODAY AS A COLD FRONT ADVANCES SWD ACROSS NEB AND IA THIS AFTERNOON. ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST ALONG AND NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY IN THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS MORNING. SOUTH OF THE FRONT...THE AIRMASS SHOULD BE CAPPED FOR MUCH OF THE DAY. THE MODELS WEAKEN THE CAP THIS AFTERNOON AND INITIATE SFC-BASED THUNDERSTORMS ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE FRONT IN A MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS. THE GREATEST CONVECTIVE THREAT SHOULD EXIST IN CNTRL AND WRN NEB WHERE THE MODELS ARE IN REASONABLE AGREEMENT CONCERNING THE POSSIBILITY FOR AN MCS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN NORTH PLATTE AT 21Z SHOW MLCAPE VALUES OF 2500 J/KG...0-6 KM SHEAR IN THE 30 TO 35 KT RANGE AND 850 TO 500 MB LAPSE RATES OF 8.0 C/KM. THIS ALONG WITH SFC TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS OF 30 DEGREES F SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT AS A LINE OF STORMS ORGANIZES AND MOVES EWD ACROSS THE REGION LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EARLY THIS EVENING. A 30 PERCENT WIND DAMAGE PROBABILITY HAS BEEN MAINTAINED ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS FOR THIS POSSIBILITY. FURTHER TO THE EAST ACROSS THE MID-MO VALLEY...THE MODELS ALSO INITIATE SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ALONG AN A

sections.title: NRN OH VALLEY AND SRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE WILL BE IN PLACE ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY TODAY WITH A LARGE AREA OF MODERATE INSTABILITY FROM WI AND LOWER MI SWD INTO IL...IND AND OH. ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SFC-BASED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO INITIATE THIS AFTERNOON ON THE NRN EDGE OF THE UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE WHERE FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES. THIS SHOULD BE SUPPORTIVE OF A WIND DAMAGE THREAT WITH THE MORE INTENSE MULTICELLS.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIRMASS WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY ACROSS THE GULF COAST STATES WHERE THE MODELS INITIATE SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON. INSTABILITY AND LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE FORECAST TO BE THE MOST FAVORABLE IN THE LOWER MS VALLEY WHERE AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT SHOULD EXIST WITH THE MORE INTENSE PULSE STORMS. ..BROYLES/ROGERS.. 07/28/2011
